slides.headline: Disney’s Free-Trial Courtroom Weapon
slides.subheadline: A streaming signup became an argument for arbitration.

items.label: Digital Assent
items.body: Disney cited streaming signup and later park-ticket terms.

items.label: Forum Control
items.body: Disney sought arbitration, not immunity from liability.

slides.visual_style: Monumental editorial typography with a forensic contract illustration.
slides.layout_topology: Oversized headline above a central hero; two compact footer columns.

primitives: Draw a white agreement sheet at x=160, y=610, width=300, height=360, with an ink outline.
Place a red checked square beneath three abstract agreement lines.
Extend a red dashed arrow from the checkbox toward a courthouse outline at x=650, y=670.
Construct the courthouse from a triangular pediment, three columns and a baseline.
Label the dashed arrow REQUESTED; do not depict a completed transfer.

svg_blueprint.typography: Heavy condensed sans headline; restrained serif body; monospaced diagram labels.
svg_blueprint.constraints: Use outlined vector icons, no logos, no numerical telemetry, no text outside assigned regions.

slides.headline: One Account. Two Service Worlds.
slides.subheadline: Disney relied on streaming consent and later parks acceptance.

items.label: Streaming Entry
items.body: The subscriber agreement incorporated broader Disney terms.

items.label: Parks Reinforcement
items.body: Disney also cited account acceptance and ticket purchases.

slides.visual_style: Restrained service-map illustration with architectural connector lines.
slides.layout_topology: Asymmetric sidebar copy beside two vertically stacked service panels.

primitives: Draw two white panels at x=620, y=220 and x=620, y=790, each width=340 and height=300.
Place a screen outline and play triangle in the upper panel; label STREAMING.
Place a notched ticket outline in the lower panel; label PARKS.
Connect the panels with a thin ink spine at x=570 and red right-angle branches.
Place a small account-outline icon on the spine between the panels.

svg_blueprint.typography: Bold grotesk headline; compact sans body; monospaced service labels.
svg_blueprint.constraints: The diagram shows contractual connections, not user volume or measured scale.

slides.headline: Two Documents, Competing Forums
slides.subheadline: Piccolo argued conflicting parks terms defeated enforcement.

items.label: Parks Terms
items.body: Specified Orange County, Florida, courts; claimed priority.

slides.visual_style: Opposing legal-document facsimiles with red conflict notation.
slides.layout_topology: Mirrored split screen with a narrow central collision seam.

primitives: Draw matching white document rectangles at x=110 and x=610, y=560, width=360, height=420.
Use abstract ink lines with one red underlined clause on each document.
Label the left document ARBITRATION and the right document COURT.
Draw inward-facing red arrows that stop before a broken vertical seam at x=540.
Place CONTESTED above the seam; do not add a winner badge.

svg_blueprint.typography: Editorial serif headline; sans body; monospaced conflict annotation.
svg_blueprint.constraints: Present the priority argument as Piccolo’s position, not a judicial ruling.

slides.headline: Build The Chain. Request Arbitration.
slides.subheadline: Disney sought arbitration and a stay of the court action.

items.label: Build Connection
items.body: Capture assent → incorporate terms → reinforce through parks.

items.label: Shift Forum
items.body: Link website allegations → invoke delegation → seek a stay.

slides.visual_style: Technical conduit schematic with deliberate gaps at disputed transitions.
slides.layout_topology: Two horizontal process lanes beneath a compact title block.

primitives: Create an upper conduit at y=760 connecting a checkbox, linked sheets and a ticket outline.
Create a lower conduit at y=1120 connecting a browser outline, delegation relay and pause symbol.
Use icon centers at x=210, x=540 and x=870 in both lanes.
Connect the upper lane to the lower lane with a right-edge return path.
Use red dashed arrows for the website-to-delegation and delegation-to-stay connections.
Keep the two lane descriptions in the assigned item regions; add no extra stage captions.

svg_blueprint.typography: Condensed sans headline; monospaced process copy.
svg_blueprint.constraints: The pause symbol means a requested court stay, not a granted stay.

slides.headline: Whose Consent Binds Whose Claim?
slides.subheadline: Piccolo challenged extending his acceptance to his wife’s estate.

items.label: Individual Assent
items.body: Disney relied on Piccolo’s personal account transactions.

items.label: Estate Boundary
items.body: Piccolo argued his acceptance could not bind the estate.

slides.visual_style: Negative-space legal perimeter diagram with an interrupted bridge.
slides.layout_topology: Diagonal separation: individual upper-left, estate lower-right.

primitives: Draw an ink circle centered at x=290, y=690, radius=130; place a person-outline icon inside.
Draw a white outlined rectangle at x=640, y=760, width=270, height=190; place a legal-file icon inside.
Label the circle PICCOLO and the rectangle ESTATE.
Draw a red dashed diagonal connector between them, interrupted by a wide paper-colored gap.
Place a red question mark in the gap instead of an arrowhead.

svg_blueprint.typography: High-contrast serif headline; neutral sans body; small uppercase diagram labels.
svg_blueprint.constraints: The separation represents contested party identity, not a resolved legal boundary.

slides.headline: Arbitration Is Not Immunity
slides.subheadline: JAMS is a private provider, not a government regulator.

items.label: Remedies Preserved
items.body: Preserve available remedies; court for unavailable remedies.

items.label: Information Exchange
items.body: Relevant, non-privileged information must be exchanged.

slides.visual_style: Consumer-standard audit sheet with restrained red verification marks.
slides.layout_topology: One large audit panel containing two generously spaced rows.

primitives: Draw a white audit panel at x=72, y=540, width=936, height=710 with a thin ink border.
Divide the panel once with a horizontal rule at y=895.
Place a balance-scale outline at x=130, y=665 and overlapping information-sheet outlines at x=130, y=995.
Add a small red check beside each icon.
Keep the item copy inside the panel; avoid decorative legal seals.

svg_blueprint.typography: Bold sans headline; readable serif body; monospaced item labels.
svg_blueprint.constraints: Checks identify JAMS baseline safeguards, not findings about procedures applied to this estate.

slides.headline: Audit Consent Before Claiming Control
slides.subheadline: Neither outcome validates the theory; no confirmed payout.
slides.visual_style: Architectural inspection gate paired with a sparse legal timeline.
slides.layout_topology: Centered strategic headline, monumental gate, two-event footer.

primitives: Draw an architectural gate from two ink uprights at x=250 and x=830 with a lintel at y=620.
Place an outlined contract sheet beneath the gate.
Run a red inspection beam horizontally across the sheet at y=800.
Place the compact audit caption SCOPE / CONFLICTS / IDENTITY beneath the beam.
Draw a separate thin footer timeline with two equal circular event markers aligned to the items.
Space timeline markers editorially, not proportionally to elapsed time.

svg_blueprint.typography: Heavy condensed headline; neutral sans body; monospaced audit caption.
svg_blueprint.constraints: Do not depict a judicial endorsement, settlement amount or causal link between the two outcomes.
